name: W Sardinia, Poltu Quatu
insider_take: This ultra-chic retreat sits on one of Sardinia's most exclusive harbors, where superyachts dock steps from your suite and the Costa Smeralda's legendary nightlife awaits.
whats_special: The hotel occupies a prime spot in Poltu Quatu, a stunning natural fjord that's home to one of the Mediterranean's most prestigious marinas. The property features dramatic cliffside architecture that seamlessly blends into the rugged Sardinian coastline, while offering direct access to pristine emerald waters that give Costa Smeralda its name.
pro_tip: Book a harbor-facing suite during late May or September for perfect weather, fewer crowds, and front-row seats to watch the parade of luxury yachts arriving from Monaco and the French Riviera.
dont_miss: The hotel's infinity pool appears to spill directly into the Mediterranean, while the nearby Porto Cervo (just 10 minutes away) offers world-class shopping and dining. Take the complimentary boat shuttle to explore hidden coves accessible only by water, including the famous Spiaggia del Principe beach.
pros: Stunning Mediterranean views from exclusive Poltu Quatu location
Contemporary W Hotels signature design and vibrant atmosphere
Premium beachfront access to pristine Sardinian coastline
Luxury amenities including world-class spa and dining venues
cons: Remote location requires travel planning to reach main attractions
Premium pricing reflects luxury positioning and exclusive setting
